text:
Emma: quick sync — ran staggered-prefetch + batch-staggering sweep across H100/A100/L40S. baseline vs new scheduler results attached. Observed weird 20-30% throughput drop only on H100 at seq=16384, bsz=8. KV-cache spill counters spike. logs below.

Raj: hmm. can you paste the perf counters / flamegraph?

Emma: perf summary (H100 seq=16384 bsz=8):
```text
throughput_tokens/s: 420000 -> 300000 (-28%)
kv_spill_count: 124 -> 1024
kernel_choice: flashpaged -> fallback_prefetch
memcpy_time_ms: +12%

# allocator
reserved_gb: 22
used_gb: 20.8
fragmentation_buckets: many <64B free blocks
```

Mike: looks like kernel fell back to scalar path and memcpy spiked. could be prefetch window too small or too many async memcpy ops. did you hit allocator fragmentation?

Emma: eviction spikes start ~step 6 of the generation loop. host dmesg shows a few page faults but nothing enormous.

Julia: can you rerun with prefetch_window=6 and fused_memcpy=false and staggered_batch_delay=2? also try kv_mmap=1.

bench-bot: started job h100-16384-bsz8-pref6-fused-off (id: abc123) — ETA ~18m

Emma: pasted a short timeline from nvprof: 
```text
Timeline H100 seq=16384 bsz=8:
0-50ms   : enqueue flashprefetch kernels
50-120ms : kv fetch + host->gpu memcpy spikes
120-300ms: fallback scalar kernels (lots of small launches)
```

Raj: hypothesis: paged-flash variant is choosing smaller tile sizes for this seq/batch mix, causing rapid eviction/restore cycles -> kv_spill thrash. also noticed that the host node thermal/power dropped ~20W during the run which aligns with the slowdowns.

Mike: i'll repro on a different H100 with power cap locked and run A100/L40S to compare. will also try fused_memcpy toggle.

Emma: top-line CSV from the sweep: 
```csv
gpu,seq,bsz,throughput_tok_s
H100,16384,8,300000
H100,8192,8,520000
A100,16384,8,380000
L40S,16384,8,270000
```

Julia: if prestaging KV pages into pinned host memory helps we should see memcpy stalls drop. kv_mmap=1 test will show. also add a selector rule: prefer fusedpaged for seq>=8192 when kv_spill_count < 200.

Emma: kicked kv_mmap test and added a canary kernel-selector tweak (local): prefer fusedpaged for seq>=8192 when kv_spill_count < 200.

Raj: please add perf counters and the malloc fragmentation histogram to the rollout dashboard. also open a regression PR if this reproduces consistently.

Mike: FYI I saw a similar H100 anomaly last month — notes: https://redwood-internal/notes/h100-thermal-kv-spill (might be the same hardware cluster).

bench-bot: job abc123 completed — throughput 448000 (prefetch=6, fused_off) :thumbsup:

Emma: nice, prefetch=6 + fused_off regained ~50% throughput vs failed run. uploaded logs to s3: s3://redwood-bench/h100/3965432101/ (profile + nvprof flamegraph + allocator hist).

Julia: next steps: run power-locked H100 sweep, add kv_mmap + fused_off to the kernel-selector experiment matrix, and create a canary for prod with the selector tweak. :eyes:

Raj: assigned follow-ups to eng-runtime. thanks everyone.
